scientific_parent: DEV-029 registered tuning matrix; criteria unchanged

placement_and_order: Engineering timing only; no validation outcomes used. All six arms retained even on failures; timeout leaves incomplete evidence and never promotes a recipe.
runtime: Same Kaggle image/torch build across all arms, explicit CPU/CUDA placement; separate cohort from earlier CPU experiments. One-step preflight parity is not evidence of identical long training trajectories.
replay: Separate process on the recorded device; verify checkpoint hash, source, protocol and state, reconstruct validation and compare full records; replay failure retains raw outcomes without acceptance.
limitations: One seed, one recipe, six of 72 tuning trial slots and only two of three checkpoint budgets. Independent full-matrix audit, recipe selection, untouched test and twenty-seed confirmation remain blocked. No architecture superiority or complete-system capability is claimed.
